g.text: Common A / PL / P; red = increase from FULL, blue = decrease. M uses the same center; G2 uses first 80
epochs. Bias ratios are actual raw widths: D0/S0 gain uses original sample0, not continued full-state
observability. M3 is shown separately; S1/S2 trajectories were not registered.
